description: An uncut 63-second player-eye clip of a small scene built from many kinds of parts on flat land, in a world of the development test game. The camera moves through the scene, passes some parts close by and others from further away, and now and then stops on one, so the game marks what the player is pointing at.
scenario: Built at the base commit with the task's injected defects applied; scripted camera path over a fixed scene (headless Xvfb capture, no input), devtest game, flat map.
